title: HyFunc: Accelerating LLM-based Function Calls for Agentic AI through Hybrid-Model Cascade and Dynamic Templating
relevance_note: Direct methodology paper on accelerating function-call generation for agents.
reason_included: Provides mechanism and latency tradeoff details for large tool surfaces.

claim_snippets.claim_text: On unseen BFCL tasks, HyFunc reports 0.828s latency with 80.1% performance, outperforming baselines at comparable scale.
Dynamic templating injects boilerplate parameter syntax on the fly inside an extended vLLM engine instead of having the model generate all structural tokens.
Its hybrid-model cascade uses a large model to distill user intent into a single soft token, then uses that signal for lightweight function retrieval and a smaller prefix-tuned generator.

HyFunc identifies three major redundancies in function calling: processing large function libraries on every request, using a large model to generate a mostly predictable sequence, and generating boilerplate syntax token by token.
